tasks.brief: Project: /tmp/vcmp/w/t2 (a node+TypeScript project using node:test). Fix the one bug in /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/pricing.ts. tasks.title: Fix inventory.ts reserve off-by-one
tasks.brief: Project: /tmp/vcmp/w/t2 (a node+TypeScript project using node:test). Fix the one bug in /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/inventory.ts. The doc comment on reserve says: "Takes qty units if that many are left; returns whether it did." The current implementation has `if (have <= qty) { return false; }` which incorrectly fails when have === qty (i.e. it should succeed in taking the last units when exactly qty are left). Fix the condition so reserve only fails when have < qty (not have <= qty), so that taking exactly the remaining stock succeeds. Do not change inStock, do not change any other file, and do not touch any test file.

tasks.brief: Project: /tmp/vcmp/w/t2 (a node+TypeScript project using node:test). Fix the one bug in /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/checkout.ts.
